text: No country is totally independent. To what extent do you agree with this claim? [30]
Schools have a responsibility to encourage young people to do more sport. Discuss. [30]
Taking a holiday in a different country has very few benefits. To what extent do you agree with
this statement? [30]
There are no good reasons to lower the voting age in your country. Evaluate this view. [30]
Animals should be free to live in the wild rather than be locked up in a zoo. Discuss. [30]
Language is the most important feature of a person’s identity. To what extent do you agree with
this view? [30]
Music without lyrics can never be meaningful. Discuss this view. [30]
Most humans will live to be more than 100 years old in the future. To what extent is this
situation desirable? [30]
Journalism has become a dangerous profession. Evaluate this statement. [30]
It is realistic to believe that the world’s environmental problems can be solved. To what extent do
you agree? [30]
